## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues (e.g. Closes #123).

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. Include terminal output or screenshots
when the user interface changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `make check` (or the equivalent commands in CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I added regression tests for behavior changes, where applicable.
- [ ] I updated documentation and translations affected by this change.
- [ ] My commits follow Conventional Commits and include a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
